stages.title: Power and midpoint
stages.purpose: Establish stable supplies before connecting expensive modules.
add: BB0 midpoint components; local regulator capacitors
Selected power regulators and an adjustable current-limited lab supply
Multimeter; dummy loads and oscilloscope for the load/ripple tests
tests: Check polarity and unpowered continuity. Leave battery, ESP32 and sensors disconnected.
Measure the selected rails and midpoint under the loads listed in the detailed procedure.
Record minimum/maximum voltages, current, startup, ripple and temperature.
stages.troubleshoot: Disconnect power; check polarity, resistor values, short circuits and supply current limit.
stages.acceptance: 3.3 V digital 3.23–3.43 V; 3.0 V analog 2.94–3.06 V; midpoint 0.49–0.51 × measured analog rail (1.47–1.53 V at a nominal 3.00 V rail). Test 0/100/300 mA digital and 0/20/50 mA analog. Ripple targets ≤50/10 mVpp (20 MHz bandwidth); step deviation ≤5%, recovery ±3% within10 ms. Temperature <60°C after10 min at20–30°C ambient. 5 V ADC:4.8–5.2 V at10–50 mA; verify never above5.25 V including startup.

stages.title: Controller and controls
stages.purpose: Prove programming, reset and controls work before adding data acquisition.
add: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 N8R8
Button, status LEDs, battery sense and USB detection components
External USB inlet; matching controller diagnostic firmware
tests: Flash the controller diagnostic profile only. Verify reset, buttons and LEDs.
Verify GPIO21 LOW with external USB attached and HIGH when absent. The diagnostic prints USB attached=1/0, the inverse of that pin level. Both DevKit onboard USB sockets remain empty.
Record repeated programming/reset results and measured current.
stages.troubleshoot: Check 5 V/3.3 V rails, boot/reset state and USB wiring; do not bypass the attachment interlock.
stages.acceptance: 20 program/reset cycles without failure. Buttons/LEDs respond. GPIO21 low when USB attached, high when absent. Measure the external 10k usb-pu (GPIO21 to 3V3D) unpowered: the diagnostic enables an internal pull-up, the recording firmware does not. Recorder must refuse to start while USB attached; that interlock needs a repeat at stage7. Record measured current; no assumed universal current limit.

stages.title: AD7606 timing and known voltages
stages.purpose: Prove accepted conversions, complete serial frames and the two input identities before adding analog boards.
add: RoboticsBD RBD-3184 AD7606 module; qualify supplies, serial strap and reference before signal leads
diagnostic-adc from firmware/builds; calibrated positive DC source and multimeter
3.3 V-compatible logic analyzer or oscilloscope; use breadboard/probe-connections.csv
tests: Before connecting ESP32 signals, verify 5 V AVCC, 3.3 V VIO, serial mode, internal reference, RANGE low and OS0–OS2 low.
Continuity: GPIO11 reaches both CVA/CVB through DIST1 a29/b29/c29. GPIO8 connects to BUSY; GPIO13 reads DB7/DOUTA.
Apply 1.000 V to V1 and 2.000 V to V2; expect ideal codes 6554/13107. Swap sources and confirm channel identity. Compute expected codes from measured source voltage.
Capture CONVST, BUSY, CS, SCLK and DOUTA: 128 clocks for all eight words, 8 MHz mode 2, idle high and falling-edge sampling. Export only V1/V2.
Discard RESET-time startup reads: one per configuration, normally one at diagnostic boot and two before the first recording session after boot. They are not measured EMG frames.
Use current v1.6 firmware; any missing BUSY assertion, timeout or unread/overlapping conversion is a failed test. Diagnostic windows intentionally pause for printing.
stages.troubleshoot: Power off and check module straps, DB7/DOUTA, CVA/CVB common strip, BUSY and grounds. AD7606 has no ID register or sensor-frame CRC. Do not change physical SPI polarity to imitate a Wokwi idle-clock limitation.
stages.acceptance: Physical gate: 125 µs trigger interval ±1%; 8 kHz ±0.1% averaged over 60 s of acquisition. CONVST high ≥25 ns. With oversampling off, conversion 3.45–4.2 µs; the firmware 80 µs wait is a fault deadline. Each measurement read has 128 clocks and completes before the next trigger. DC error ≤65 codes plus measured source/meter uncertainty. Zero unexplained timeout/overrun/errors. See docs/breadboard-refinements.html for probe contacts and startup-read interpretation.

stages.title: First analog channel
stages.purpose: Test one full EMG input path with a synthetic signal.
add: BB1 analog components and protection adapter
Signal generator and oscilloscope
ADC diagnostic firmware; no MyoWare or electrodes
tests: Use synthetic-input-tests.md for the exact signal and return connections.
Start at 1.5 V offset and 100 mVpp; verify voltage before connection.
Measure offset, frequency response, noise and unplugged bias using the detailed limits.
Keep unity RAW reconstruction: signed code × 5 / 32768 volts. The 1.5 V unplugged bias is separate from input_midpoint_mv=0 metadata.
stages.troubleshoot: Inspect IC notch, component values, protection adapter orientation and signal-generator load setting.
stages.acceptance: DC gain1; two3.3k/47nF low-pass stages. Compare gain against simulations/results/response.csv tolerance envelope; allow additional±0.5 dB measurement/model margin. Unplugged RAW→1.50 V±30 mV after settling. Record RMS noise over20–500 Hz; provisional target<2 mVrms input-referred, to be reviewed for research suitability. Check clipping using safe0.1–2.9 V sources, never±5 V into3 V buffers.

stages.title: Second EMG channel
stages.purpose: Verify EMG1 and EMG2 independently, then together in this fixed two-input build.
add: BB2 complete second analog path and its protection adapter
Synthetic signal source; fixed-two diagnostic-adc profile
tests: Repeat the first-channel offset and frequency tests on BB2. Populate exactly BB1 and BB2; this board has no EMG3/EMG4 ports.
Inject a distinct signal into one input at a time, then swap the signals. Verify EMG1/2 identity and common frame timestamp.
Hold the undriven RAW port at midpoint, measure crosstalk and preserve the baseline and generator-feedthrough trace.
Only the two enabled inputs may appear as muscle measurements in CSV/live display; unused ADC words are still clocked but are not exported as EMG.
stages.troubleshoot: Check channel order, midpoint impedance, ground returns and wire coupling. Use the fixed-two firmware; ADC V3–V8 are not additional EMG ports.
stages.acceptance: Enabled channels match physical ports; disabled channels absent from CSV/live display. Simultaneous channel samples share trigger/frame timestamp. Project crosstalk screen <−40 dB versus driven signal, with generator feedthrough measured separately. Zero unexplained errors in10 min.

stages.title: Foot and shank ICM sensors
stages.purpose: Bring up the foot carrier first, then the shank, while keeping independent identities and timing evidence.
add: MIKROE-4237 ICM-42688-P carriers, first foot then shank; JP2–JP4 SPI positions 1–2 and 3.3 V supply
diagnostic-imu-one then diagnostic-imu-two from this variant
Logic analyzer on SPI and each INT1; use the probe table
tests: Verify carrier supply, SPI jumpers and header orientation before signal leads. Shared MOSI GPIO4, MISO GPIO5, SCLK GPIO6.
Foot CS/INT1 are GPIO7/16; shank CS/INT1 are GPIO15/17. Rotate one carrier at a time to prove identity and axis signs.
Check WHO_AM_I 0x47, configuration readback, both 200 Hz interrupt streams and FIFO packet counts. Missing first IRQ beyond 100 ms, FIFO overflow or invalid packet is a failure.
During recording, retain raw 16-bit sensor timestamps, read_start_us/read_end_us and IRQ anchors. Normal counter rollover is every 65.536 ms; host times remain estimates.
Foot/shank startup counts may differ. Do not pair rows by index or reject a sample merely because it arrived during a FIFO read. The converter checks the read-end bound.
stages.troubleshoot: Check SPI selection, shared GPIO4/5/6, distinct CS and INT1 wires, cable integrity and 3.3 V. Flag 2 means uncertain host-time reconstruction; gap/invalid flags and sensor/timing stop reasons require investigation.
stages.acceptance: WHO_AM_I 0x47 and readback pass. 200 Hz ±1% per sensor over 60 s; diagnostic tick_step_mean 5000 ±0.5% and mean host_us_per_tick 1.00 ±1% over ≥60 windows; no overflow, missing-IRQ or invalid-packet errors. ±16 g / ±2000 °/s configured; stationary gravity-axis within ±0.1 g of ±1 g, other axes within ±0.1 g and gyro per axis <5 °/s before calibration. Confirm identities, axis signs and cable length; characterize synchronization separately.

stages.title: SD recording
stages.purpose: Make reliable local recording work before enabling wireless reception.
add: Adafruit 4682 SD interface and suitable microSD card
Breadboard SD-only recording firmware; GPIO47 is CMD
tests: Use breadboard-sd-only-2ch with SDMMC CMD GPIO47, CLK GPIO39, D0 GPIO40; check all five Adafruit 4682 contacts.

Record synthetic inputs for 60 minutes, then for a full 2-hour session until the firmware stops with reason 5 (session limit). Wait for recording LED off, then convert the untouched SD files. A filename or END alone cannot prove persistence.

Check AD7606 / two enabled inputs / ICM identities / breadboard metadata, unity RAW-voltage scaling, CRC32, counters, timing flags, END and stop reason. ADC-specific CRC/status columns are intentionally blank.
Test missing/full card and interrupted recording on expendable media. Recovery must report a truncated tail/missing END; keep partial runs labeled.
Repeat USB-attachment inhibition and sync/close error checks. GPIO21 is active low; preserve explicit stop/error evidence.
stages.troubleshoot: Check the breadboard profile and GPIO47/39/40, local card supply and queues. Keep original files and quality.json; never replace saved SD evidence with the wireless preview.
stages.acceptance: 60 min and full 2 h runs, no unexplained SD sample loss, CRC errors or queue overflow; final queue_high_water ≤10,240 of 20,480; card make/model/capacity/speed class recorded; quality.json imu_clock median_tick_step 5000 ±0.5% and host_us_per_sensor_tick within ±1%. Refuse start without SD; report full-card stop. Recovery preserves complete valid records and reports truncated tail/missing END. Attach USB during synthetic recording: explicit stop.

stages.title: Wi-Fi and SD
stages.purpose: Confirm wireless reception does not compromise the SD recording.
add: Breadboard recording profile with Wi-Fi enabled
Laptop receiver and converter; existing SD setup
tests: Read the recorder's Wi-Fi password once from the USB console at the bench (it is generated on first boot and printed at every boot), store it privately, then remove USB. Use breadboard-record-2ch while SD recording continues for 60 minutes; only EMG1/2 may appear.
Disconnect/reconnect Wi-Fi and confirm visible wireless gaps. Preserve the laptop archive and its quality report.
Audit the original SD file separately: a Wi-Fi gap is not automatically SD loss, and a plausible preview cannot certify saved data.
Compare channel identities, timestamps, scaling and stop/error indications across both archives. Keep all unexplained SD gaps, CRC or queue failures visible.
stages.troubleshoot: Check network selection, firewall, receiver port, supply stability and queue counters.
stages.acceptance: 60 min with two channels: stage7 SD quality maintained; only enabled channels displayed; induced packet loss visible in counters/gaps. Compare SD versus laptop capture.

stages.title: Battery operation
stages.purpose: Replace laboratory power and measure actual runtime.
add: Protected battery with verified polarity
Complete recorder; lab supply disconnected at BOTH leads
tests: Check source polarity before attaching the battery. Never parallel it with the lab supply.
Record repeated startups and a continuous run of at least two hours.
Document battery identity, charge state, configuration, ambient temperature and shutdown behavior.
stages.troubleshoot: Check converter droop, battery protection and temperature. Do not infer runtime from nominal capacity alone.
stages.acceptance: Measured≥2 h intended-use runtime;20 startup/shutdown cycles; successful60 min trial; no unexpected reset. Record pack capacity, age, voltage, configuration and ambient temperature.

stages.title: MyoWare integration
stages.purpose: Replace synthetic inputs with the bare sensors only after acquisition passes.
add: Two bare MyoWare 2.0 sensors initially
Verified VIN/GND/RAW wiring, strain relief and wearable mounting
tests: First connect sensors with no person attached; check power and RAW output.
Verify secure mounting and clearance around the AFO.
Supervised human recordings require institutional and electrical-safety approval; no USB, charging or mains-connected instruments while electrodes are attached.
stages.troubleshoot: Investigate saturation, wrong output pad, motion artifacts and cable strain before any wearable session.
stages.acceptance: Secure strain relief/mounting; no cable pull on electrodes. Institutional approval, consent and electrical-safety review completed before supervised human testing. No charging or mains/USB/instrument cables attached to a person.
